scope.head: Report598 restrictions
scope.roots: Any number of distinct outside nodes with the same two head parents; unchanged Report601 finite choices and rectangle tail
scope.nonroots: Increasing distinct outside primes, each with two fixed earlier parents and at least one outside parent; parents may come from different roots of this same head pair
scope.sharing: All nodes of one network share one head pair; different networks have disjoint outside nodes and no cross-network originals
scope.originals: Distinct full numerical labels, one globally fixed residue each, arbitrary finite heights; unique largest-prime owner
scope.ordinary: Report599 private trees with disjoint interiors; Type I and separate components unchanged
scope.source: One normalized forward law from product Haar on the head pair; root rows use selected-complement Haar, nonroot rows capped at six; no primary amplification
scope.excluded: Unrestricted head labels; multiple parent inventories at one node; different-head-pair network crossings; non-increasing network order
